classification: Verifier assumption defect, not product/test failure
failed_assertion: assert all(current_artifacts[p]==r for p,r in old_artifacts.items())
observation: The existing QP01 README is one of the three authorized navigation edits; only its current artifact SHA changed. No old artifact path was removed. The verifier incorrectly required all old rows to remain byte-identical.
correction:
assert set(old_artifacts)<=set(current_artifacts)
reconciled=[p for p,r in old_artifacts.items() if current_artifacts[p]!=r]
assert reconciled==['docs/restart/implementation/QP01/README.md']
